title: Check: upgrades
description: Five questions on moving a cluster to a new version.

questions.prompt: What is the correct order when upgrading a cluster?

options.text: Workers first, then the control plane
Control plane first, then workers one at a time

questions.explanation: The control plane may run ahead of the kubelets, never behind. Upgrade it first, then drain and upgrade each worker.

questions.prompt: How far may a kubelet lag behind the API server?
questions.explanation: Modern policy allows kubelets up to three minor versions older than the API server, but never newer.

questions.prompt: Can you upgrade from 1.30 straight to 1.32 with kubeadm?

options.text: No - upgrade one minor version at a time, 1.30 to 1.31 to 1.32

questions.explanation: kubeadm refuses the jump. Minor versions must be walked one at a time.

questions.prompt: Write the command that safely drains node worker-1 before upgrading its kubelet.
questions.explanation: --ignore-daemonsets is needed because DaemonSet Pods are deliberately not evictable.

questions.prompt: Which command shows the upgrade paths available from the current version?
questions.explanation: `plan` reports the versions you can move to and what it will change; `apply` performs it.
